summary: Backend rigorous testing of SAR API - 14/14 tests passed. Validated no-forzar CON DIFERENCIAS behavior (no records stored), forzar=true import (16 records for ECATEPEC sem 26), idempotency, OMITIDO for non-audit files, semanas/registros/dashboard/comparativo/imports endpoints, reports (semanal/mensual/anual) as valid xlsx with Ecatepec row populated (col 6 auditados >0, col 64 negado), 404 for missing week, and DELETE registros.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes TOTAL_TIENDAS=17; consider making configurable via env or master data.
import endpoint accepts forzar via Form; boolean parsing relies on FastAPI defaults ('true'/'false' strings). Works but consider explicit str->bool coercion for robustness.
generar_concentrado loads template from disk on every request - fine for now but could be cached in-memory for perf.
seed_data_creation: Tests import /app/tests/samples/checklist_sem26.xlsx into semana 26/2026; cleaned up before and after run via DELETE /api/registros.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All SAR backend endpoints validated with sample file. Test file uses pytest-xdist (2 workers) but tests within one file run in one worker due to LoadScopeScheduling, so ordering is preserved. If DB is not clean, first test may fail - clean_state fixture handles it.
